_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Base-rate coil (score rarely moves ±2 in 12h) plus diverging mini-top heat and flat funding keep the ladder pinned to Hope until F&G/momentum expand or flush.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicit HOLD/Hope; narrative supplies bearish-leaning positioning detail but does not contradict the coil or demand a rung change
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G stays 55-70, 30d momentum positive but sub-parabolic, funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G >71 with expanding funding/momentum (Optimism) or F&G <55 on a flush (Disbelief)
